title: Teodoro: China sanctions won't change PH rights in West Philippine Sea
summary: In a no-holds-barred statement, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. slammed China over reported plans to impose sanctions on Filipino lawmakers who have spoken out against Beijing.
